newsitem.title: USA: Italian Oven files for Chapter 11.
newsitem.headline: Italian Oven files for Chapter 11.

text.p: Italian Oven Inc said on Monday it had filed for protection from its creditors under Chapter 11 of the Bankruptcy Code and is seeking to reorganize.

Garvin Warden of Cornerstone Capital Advisors Ltd, who was named Italian Over chief executive in June, said in a statement that the company's efforts to attract investors had been unsuccessful so far.
Potential investors who were approached have been unwilling to consider committing funds without the protection afforded by Chapter 11 bankruptcy reorganization, he said.
Italian Ovens said it intends to keep all of its stores open, plans no immediate layoffs, and intends to keep fully supporting its franchisees.
For the second quarter the company reported a net loss of $3.68 million, or $0.85 per share.
